SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.open_date, s.close_date,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store x ON x.store_key=f.store_key WHERE x.store_id=s.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS lines,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store x ON x.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.store_id=s.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND NOT d.is_trading_day) AS lines_closed_days,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store x ON x.store_key=f.store_key JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=x.store_id WHERE x.store_id=s.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS lines_in_refit
FROM dim_store s WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900 AND (lines = 0 OR lines_closed_days > 0 OR lines_in_refit > 0 OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL OR s.open_date IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
